command:
set -e
# User explicitly authorized card 7 after the occupancy report.
source /usr/local/Ascend/cann-9.0.0/set_env.sh
source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
export TORCH_DEVICE_BACKEND_AUTOLOAD=0 ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7 VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
export LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libjemalloc.so.2
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/9.0.0/atb/cxx_abi_1/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}
probe_health="$(npu-smi info -t health -i 7 -c 0)"
printf '%s\n' "$probe_health"
[[ "$probe_health" == *': OK'* ]] || exit 1
cd /vllm-workspace/vllm-ascend
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
exec /usr/local/python3.12.13/bin/python3 -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server --model /workspace/models/clef-flash --served-model-name clef-flash --hf-overrides '{"architectures":["ClefForSystemOne"]}' --dtype bfloat16 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18123 --distributed-executor-backend uni --enforce-eager --shutdown-timeout 30 --max-model-len 3072 --max-num-seqs 1 --max-num-batched-tokens 3072 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.7 --block-size 128 --no-enable-prefix-caching --no-async-scheduling --no-enable-chunked-prefill --worker-cls vllm_ascend.clef.worker.ClefWorker --additional-config '{"clef":{"enabled":true}}'
purpose: Explicit user authorization to launch idle Clef-flash on physical NPU 7 after occupancy report
